description: Check whether a package name is available before creating a new app. Derived from web decompile recon, not the official API — uses the Play Console web session, not the service account.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id, from your console URL (play.google.com/console/u/N/developers/{this}/...).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm the right one with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

package_name.description: Target Android package name, e.g. com.example.myapp.

name: check_package_name_availability
